label: owns organization or asset
definition: Person or organization X owns or owned some or all of organization, business, team or property Y.
scope_notes: Includes: owner/co-owner/owns; explicit ownership interest or stated share; corporate parent; completed acquisition with ownership attachment; historical ownership. Excludes: management or leadership alone; publishing or distribution alone; mere collaboration; proposed or rejected acquisition. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: merger without clear ownership direction; a possessive alone. This states ownership interest, not necessarily complete ownership or control. An explicit partial stake qualifies here but not automatically as subsidiary_of in reverse.
